title: opscale-sipoc — sipoc.json
description: Validated source of truth for the module's SIPOCs — exactly one per BPMN first-level logic operation. The rendered sipoc/<id>.md files are a deterministic projection of this file. The SIPOC↔bpmn link is purely by id: the derivable fields (operation/subprocess/step) live on the matching bpmn logic op, and process[] references that op's composed operation codes.

sipocs.description: One SIPOC per BPMN first-level `type:"logic"` operation (semantic rule enforces the 1:1).

id.description: == the BPMN logic op id; the sipoc/<id>.md filename. The only link to bpmn.json — operation/subprocess/step are derived by matching this id to the logic op.

title.description: Short action title in the source language — rendered as the H1 (`# SIPOC — <title>`).

description.description: One-sentence description of what the Action does — the paragraph under the header block; becomes the generated Action's description.

businessRules.description: The module's canonical BR registry — each rule defined once (module-unique), with its `code` and full `text`. The header lists the codes; the `## Business Rules` section lists code — text. `process[].rule` resolves against these codes.

composes.description: Leaf logic ids this one invokes; may be [].

inputs.description: ATOMIC — each input is a single scalar value with a business-type `type` from sipocInputType.

source.description: Plain-text actor that provides the input (e.g. "User", "System").

type.description: Business type — NEVER an ambiguous type (snippet, metadata, …). sipocInputType is businessType minus those.

process.description: Ordered steps — each REFERENCES a composed operation of the matching bpmn logic op (by its composed op `code`). render appends the final `return result`.

operation.description: A composed op `code` from the matching bpmn logic op's `operations[]` (e.g. SP-01-02-L01-C01). Semantic checks membership.

outputs.description: ATOMIC — each output is a single scalar value. `type` = businessType slug | 'bool' | entity code (resolved in semantic).

consumer.description: Plain-text actor that consumes the output (e.g. "User", "System", "All callers").

type.description: A businessType slug, the literal 'bool', or a kebab entity code. Membership is checked in the semantic pass against common businessTypes + sibling dbml.json.
